notes.title: Bug Fix v1.07
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug for Chinese localization, when after starting a new game the game saved the progress.
- Increased player stamina
- Lock highlighting if you try to pick it in the dark
- Minor fixes

notes.title: French Language!
notes.content:
Thanks to Nolan Berthault, French has been added to the game.
Also fixed:
- Kerosene canister now has a stack of 1000 units
- Errors in Chinese text
- Some music and sounds were not linked to the overall volume
- Added Visual cues
- If the game is incorrectly saved in the museum location, you will be teleported to the right place
- Chest at level 1 no longer disappears after saving
- Minor edits

notes.title: First Bug Fix
notes.content:
Added level 3 autosave
Door in one of the paintings fixed
Tall man appears less often
Fixed painting that could not be accessed due to game crashing
Fixed Tall Man's behavior
One of the achievements now appears on time
Doors can no longer be opened with the body, only by running.
Fixed non-disappearing model screemer
Fixed soft lock on hints

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039565/5ddb0119d6e10423cd52d6a0ecc31bbde8c351ba.png
The updated demo is ready and waiting in the wings!

 Added Italian language
 Menu tabs for easier navigation
 Added a separate hero volume slider
 The color scheme has changed
 A list of tasks appeared in the form of a notepad in your hands
 The ring is used on a separate button
 A kerosene lamp may go out randomly
 Almost all known bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42039565/deda72622f0217683a7b1ecf00a1da20d610873d.png
Big demo update.
Added:
- Simplified Chinese
- Spanish
- German
- Turkish language
- Fixed English language
Bugs:
- Items and triggers after painting do not reappear
- Pause now works on Esc
- Game volume can be increased
- Fixed collision of some items
- Fixed a bug with the player's body during the inspection of items
- Items in the box are now taken on LMB
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to move while inspecting items
- Improved hints

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
